items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against amended income tax assessment
items.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 11.06.2026, sent as simple letter (einfacher Brief). Under § 122 Abs. 2 AO (as amended 2025) a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, unless that day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, in which case delivery shifts to the next business day. Counting from 11.06.2026: 12.06 (+1, Fri), 13.06 (+2, Sat), 14.06 (+3, Sun), 15.06.2026 (+4, Mon) = deemed Bekanntgabe day. 15.06.2026 is a Monday and not a NRW public holiday, so no shift needed. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 AO) begins with Bekanntgabe; per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (applied via § 108 AO), the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 15.07.2026. 15.07.2026 is a Wednesday and not a NRW public holiday, so the deadline stands.
